description: Scheduling — two PreToolUse hooks: (1) advisory steer toward the parse/generate scripts for managed HTML artifacts (project-context.html); (2) lib-fence advisory recommending the Westland Scheduler Local MCP tools instead of reading schedule-toolbox/lib/*.py directly — emits permissionDecision:allow with a tool-mapped reason so Claude sees the recommendation but is not blocked from debugging an MCP failure. Both run through the Python wrapper (run-hook.ps1) that skips the Microsoft Store python.exe stub.
